page.layout: One page of text, two columns of running text in the main block with a heading "Canon 2." and "Explicatio." centred; marginal notes in the left margin (two notes: "1. Asia-" and "ticum"). Running head "Imperia" at top with page number "20" at top left.

main_text.p: xandri familia superfuit, abstinuerunt a titulo regio, eumq; concesserunt primo quidem Philippo Aridaeo, qui erat frater Alexandri, deinde filiis: Alexandro, Herculi, & tandem filiae Cleopatrae. Quibus omnibus necatis, tum demum in V. haec regna imperium Macedonicum diviserunt.
main_text.head: Canon 2.
main_text.p: 1. Asia-ticumEx regno Asiae nata regna Pergami, Bithyniae, Cappadociae, Ponti.
main_text.head: Explicatio.
main_text.p: Regnum Asiae invasit Antigonus, vetustissimus Ducum Alexandri, ludq; varia fortuna ad alium Demetrium transmisit, cum quo & extinctum fuit. Ex huius regni naufragio, veluti tabulae quaedam enatarunt regna Pergami, Bithyniae, Cappadociae & Ponti, quae paulo post in Romanorum potestatem concessere. Ca-

page.notes: Printed text "Imperia" running head and page number "20" read as printed. Words in the margin notes read as "1. Asia-" and "ticum" (the second partly cut off). Some doubtful letters in the first paragraph: "Macedonicum" read as "Mac donicum" with a gap; "Herculi" partly obscured. Catchword "Ca-" at the foot.
